## Localization & Go‑to‑Market Blueprint (Budget‑Constrained, 2026)

| Region | Dubbing Preference (RPI) | Cultural/Legal Risks | Fandom Dynamics |
|--------|--------------------------|----------------------|-----------------|
| **SEA** | 69 % dub (↑ +7 % this year) | Low regulatory burden; high privacy concern | High‑velocity fan‑generated memes & cross‑region events |
| **ME** | 49 % dub (↓ ‑5 % this year) | Strong linguistic & religious sensitivities; Arabic‑script licensing | Slow‑moving, tightly knit fan guilds; strong regional influencers |
| **LAT** | 30 % dub (stable) | Moderate censorship; VAT/royalty regimes | Vibrant remix culture; high participation in fan‑translation projects |
| **EU** | 51 % dub (↑ +3 %) | Strict EU copyright, GDPR; voice‑actor labor law | Highly monetised fandom (merch & DAO‑based); intense quality expectations |

> **RPI‑Trigger** – Any region’s |∆RPI| > 10 % warrants a media‑mix refresh (see §2.1).

---

### 1️⃣ Vision & Goals

| Goal | KPI | Time‑frame |
|------|-----|------------|
| **Maximize Incremental Subscribers** | +8 % YoY across slate | 2026‑Q4 |
| **Optimize Cost‑Per‑View (CPV)** | < €0.18 per 5‑min viewing window | 2026‑Q3 |
| **Engage Trans‑national Fandoms** | 25 % of all fandom interactions co‑created across regions | 2027‑Q2 |
| **Maintain Brand Integrity** | 0 legal or cultural compliance breaches | Ongoing |

> **Budget Cap** – $M (Replace “$M” with the user’s actual figure).  
> All allocations below are expressed as a % of the cap.

---

### 2️⃣ Cost‑Segmentation Model

| Cost Item | % of Total | Rationale |
|-----------|------------|-----------|
| **Core Tier‑1 Studio (High‑profile titles)** | 45 % | Superior voice‑actor quality, guaranteed delivery |
| **AI‑Dub & Semi‑Automatic QA (Tier‑2)** | 20 % | Volume‑driving, cost‑elastic |
| **Post‑Production & QA** | 12 % | Sync, mastering, cultural polishing |
| **Legal & Regulatory** | 7 % | Translation‑rights, compliance approvals |
| **Fandom‑Engagement & Community** | 6 % | Platforms, contests, ambassador payouts |
| **Marketing & Ad‑Tech** | 9 % | Paid promos, cross‑channel lift |
| **Contingency (Buffer)** | 1 % | Unplanned delays, currency swings |

> *Tip*: Negotiate *volume‑discount* thresholds of ≥ 10 titles per quarter to shave 6 % off Tier‑1 & Tier‑2 rates.

---

### 3️⃣ Regional Allocation Blueprint

| Region | % of Total Budget | % Core Studio | % AI‑Dub | % Marketing |
|--------|-------------------|---------------|----------|-------------|
| **SEA** | 30 % | 50 % | 30 % | 15 % |
| **ME** | 20 % | 30 % | 20 % | 15 % |
| **LAT** | 20 % | 20 % | 40 % | 15 % |
| **EU** | 30 % | 40 % | 20 % | 25 % |

**Why?**  
- SEA & EU’s higher dub‑RPI justifies a larger Core‑Studio allocation.  
- LAT’s sub‑orientation and fan‑translation culture enables a leaner AI‑dub share.  
- ME’s cautious legal environment demands tighter budget but can be supported by AI‑dub where cultural checks pass.

---

### 4️⃣ Execution Phase‑by‑Phase

| Month | Activity | Regional Focus | Owner | Deliverable |
|-------|----------|----------------|-------|-------------|
| **May** | **RPI Finalization & Tier‑Re‑Assessment** | All | Data‑Science | Updated RPI + Media‑Mix Triage |
| **June** | **Studio Contracts & AI Vendor On‑boarding** | SEA, EU, LAT | Ops | Signed SLAs, AI‑hub access |
| **July** | **Pilot Dubbing (5 flagship titles)** | SEA, ME | Production | Core Studios + AI‑Dub output |
| **Aug‑Sep** | **Compliance & Cultural Review Cycle** | ME, EU | Legal | CS‑Checklist pass, legal clearance |
| **Oct** | **Fan Community Build‑out** | All | Community Lead | Portal launch + ambassador program |
| **Nov–Dec** | **Full Slate Release + Initial Marketing Push** | All | Marketing | Global launch + localized ad spend |
| **Jan–Feb 2027** | **Performance Review & Budget Re‑allocation** | All | Finance | KPI reporting, re‑allocation of 10 % to EU & SEA |
| **Mar‑Jun 2027** | **Scale AI‑Dub & Iterate Fan Engagement** | LAT, ME | Tech & Community | 30 % AI‑dub increase, cross‑regional meme contest |

---

### 5️⃣ Technical & Creative Pillars

#### 5.1 Studio Selection Matrix  
| Region | Tier‑1 (Studio+Full Voice‑Casting) | Tier‑2 (AI‑Dub + Human QA) | Notes |
|--------|------------------------------------|---------------------------|-------|
| SEA | “Studio Pacific” (Philippines)  | “AI‑Voice Hub” (cloud) | High‑volume, moderate cost |
| ME | “Arabic Voice Studio” (Egypt)   | “AI‑Dub Middle East” | Need local dialect training |
| LAT | “Spanish/Portuguese Studio” (Lima) | “AI‑Dub LAT” | Lower studio rates, high‑quality AI |
| EU | “Central Studio” (Germany) | “AI‑Dub EU” | Strict labor & copyright checks |

#### 5.2 AI‑Dub QA Workflow  
1. **Auto‑Clone Confidence** – > 0.90 → continue 2‑phase QA; < 0.90 → Human dub.  
2. **Sync Accuracy** – < 40 ms jitter.  
3. **Cultural Sanity Check** – CS‑Checklist Pass.  
4. **Phonetic Match** – ≥ 97 % dialogue fidelity.  
5. **Final Human‑Spotting** – 30 min per 1‑h episode.  

> **Cost Breakdown Example (30‑min epi, ME, AI‑Dub)**  
>  - AI‑Clone Setup: €800  
>  - Human QA (30 min × $4) = €120  
>  - Post‑mix: €150  
>  - Total: €1070 (≈ 26 % cheaper than full studio)

#### 5.3 Post‑Production Standard
- **SYNC**: 5‑ms tolerance window.  
- **EQ & Mastering**: Studio‑level or AI‑auto‑equalizer (based on chosen tier).  
- **Localized Metadata**: Titles, tags, subtitle timings per platform guidelines.

---

### 6️⃣ Compliance & Cultural Safeguards

| Region | Key Legal Check | Cultural Edit Requirement | Verification Method |
|--------|-----------------|---------------------------|---------------------|
| SEA | PDPA, age‑rating | Avoid religious slurs | Automated script scrub, local legal sign‑off |
| ME | Censorship & “Moral Content” clause | No explicit references to water spirits | CS‑Checklist + human review |
| LAT | GDPR for transcripts | Omit references to colonial history | Data‑privacy audit + local counsel |
| EU | EU Copyright, voice‑actor union | Accurate gender representation | Union contract + quality audit |

> **Escalation** – If *any* approval stalls > 50 % of release window, abort that title’s launch and re‑schedule.

---

### 7️⃣ Fandom‑Engagement Engine (Cross‑Regional)

| Tactic | Regional Deployment | KPI |
|--------|---------------------|-----|
| **“Fan‑Dub Challenge”** – Submit your own voice‑over; best gets merch | LAT, ME, SEA | +12 % fan‑generated content |
| **“Local Legend” Podcast** – Storytelling about title’s adaptation journey | EU | +5 % NPS |
| **Community Discord (EU‑LAT)** – Trans‑regional chats, events | EU, LAT | +20 % cross‑region members |
| **Ambassador Token Program** – Earn tokens for community contributions | All | 30 % token redemption |  

> *Budget hit*: 6 % of total budget earmarked for community platform hosting, event prizes, and token distribution.

---

### 8️⃣ Marketing & Media‑Mix

| Channel | Core Region | Strategy | Spend % of Marketing Budget |
|---------|-------------|----------|-----------------------------|
| TikTok | SEA, ME | 15‑sec “Behind‑the‑Voice” reels | 30 % |
| Instagram Reels | EU, LAT | “Dub vs Sub” swipe‑carousel | 25 % |
| Facebook Groups | LAT, ME | Fan‑translation teasers; meme contests | 15 % |
| Discord & Discord‑based events | EU, LAT | Live Q&A; fan‑dev polls | 10 % |
| Branded Influencers | All | Region‑specific voice‑actor spotlights | 20 % |

**Event Calendar Highlights**

- **Global Fan‑Event (Q3 2026)** – Simultaneous release + live AMA across all platforms.  
- **Regional “Retro‑Dub” Nights** – Re‑dubbing older classics for nostalgia.  
- **“Fan‑Translation Spotlight” Week (Lat)** – User‑generated subtitles showcase.

---

### 9️⃣ Risk Matrix & Mitigation Plan

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation | Budget Buffer |
|------|------------|--------|------------|----------------|
| Studio Delay | Medium | 2‑month release hold | 3‑month backup studio contract | 5 % |
| AI‑Dub Cultural Slip | Low | Brand backlash | Mandatory CS‑Checklist, human QA | 2 % |
| Legal Change (ME) | High | Title removal | Real‑time compliance alerts | 5 % |
| Fan‑Generated Leak | Low | Reputation damage | Watermark, fast‑scrub | 1 % |
| Currency Volatility | Medium | Cost overrun | Hedge 6‑month forward | 3 % |
| Platform Outage | Low | Churn spike | 2‑hr redundancy | 2 % |

---

### 🔟 ROI & Performance Dashboard

| Metric | Target | Tool | Review Cadence |
|--------|--------|------|----------------|
| ΔSubscribers (per region) | +5 k/region | Platform analytics | Monthly |
| CPV | < €0.18 | Ad‑tech SDK | Weekly |
| NPS | ≥ 45 | SurveyHub | Quarterly |
| Fandom Interaction Ratio | > 25 % | Community portal | Monthly |
| Legal Breaches | 0 | Compliance Tracker | Ongoing |

---

## Decision & Next‑Step Checklist

| Action | Owner | Deadline | Status |
|--------|-------|----------|--------|
| 1️⃣ Enter “$M” into cost matrix → generate region‑wise spend | Finance | ASAP | Pending |
| 2️⃣ Approve Tier‑1 Studio partners for SEA/EU | Ops | End‑May | Pending |
| 3️⃣ Sign AI‑Dub vendor contracts (MEA, LAT) | Tech | End‑Jun | Pending |
| 4️⃣ Launch CS‑Checklist & legal audit for first pilot | Legal/CS | End‑Jun | Pending |
| 5️⃣ Roll out fan‑community portal (Lat, ME) | Community | End‑Aug | Pending |

> **Immediate**: Validate the cost model for your exact budget cap, then iterate “RPI‑adjusted media mix” to re‑balance spend if a region’s RPI changes unexpectedly.

---

### Epilogue

This strategy blends **data‑driven audience insight**, **cost‑effective production architecture**, and **dynamic fan‑engagement initiatives** into a single, budget‑aware operating plan. By anchoring localization to each region’s RPI, cultural compliance, and fandom vitality, the platform can maximize subscriber lift, protect its brand, and sustain a vibrant global fan ecosystem—all while staying comfortably within the defined funding envelope.

**Korean‑Content Localization & Marketing Playbook – 2026**

---

## 1️⃣ Executive Overview

| Element | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| **Strategic Intent** | Expand audience reach & retention of Korean‑drama & film titles across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Latin America, and Europe, while respecting local cultural norms, legal frameworks, and fandom dynamics. |
| **Revenue Lens** | Incremental subscriber lift, increased ad‑revenue per title, and higher lifetime value (LTV) from engaged Korean‑content viewers. |
| **Budget Flexibility** | Model is built for any total localization budget **$X M**; user can plug in the desired cap. |
| **Key Deliverables** | • Scalable cost model • Audience‑driven media mix • Cultural & legal compliance tools • AI‑dub safety net • Fandom‑engagement engine • ROI & KPIs • Cross‑functional governance • Implementation roadmap |

---

## 2️⃣ Audience Preference Engine (A‑PE)

### 2.1 Audience Preference Survey (APS)

| Activity | Frequency | Output |
|----------|-----------|--------|
| *In‑platform micro‑survey*: 30 s post‑watch “What did you like about the audio?” | Bi‑weekly | Raw preference scores per locale |
| *Third‑party panel*: 200‑person sample per region | Quarterly | Benchmarked preference shares (dub vs sub) |
| *Social‑media listening*: Mentions of “dubbing” vs “subtitles” | Continuous | Sentiment & trend signal |

### 2.2 Regional Preference Index (RPI)

> **RPI = (Ψ × 100)** where **Ψ** is the weighted average of individual preference scores (0 = only subtitles, 1 = only dubbing).  
> **Trigger**: If |∆RPI| > 10 % vs previous 3‑month window, re‑evaluate media mix.

| Region | Base RPI (July‑2023) | 2024‑Q1 RPI | 2024‑Q2 RPI |
|--------|---------------------|-------------|-------------|
| SEA | 62 % (dub) | 65 % | 69 % |
| ME | 52 % (dub) | 54 % | 49 % |
| LAT | 35 % (dub) | 33 % | 30 % |
| EU | 48 % (dub) | 47 % | 51 % |

*Action*: SEA increases dub coverage to **70 %** of new releases; LAT keeps sub‑oriented but experiments with 35 % dubbed pilots.

---

## 3️⃣ Scalable Cost Modeling

### 3.1 Template

> **Total Spend** = Σ<sub>i</sub> ( **Localisation Cost per Title** × **Number of Titles** )  
> **Localisation Cost** = **Script Translation** + **Voice‑Actor** + **Studio** + **Post‑mix** + **Licensing & Taxes**

| Cost Item | Unit | Typical % of Total | Comments |
|-----------|------|-------------------|----------|
| Script Trans. | $/kh | 15 % | Includes QA |
| Voice‑actor | $/hr | 25 % | Hours depend on runtime |
| Studio fee | $/min | 35 % | Pre‑mix, sync, sound |
| Post‑mix & QA | $/min | 15 % | Editing & mastering |
| Licensing & Taxes | $/title | 10 % | VAT, local royalties |

**Example for a 30‑min episode (SEA, dub)**  
| Item | Cost | % |
|------|------|---|
| Translation | $500 | 15 % |
| Voice‑actor (8 hrs @ $50/hr) | $400 | 12 % |
| Studio (30 min @ $15/min) | $450 | 13 % |
| Post‑mix | $150 | 4 % |
| Lic./Taxes | $200 | 6 % |
| **Total** | **$1700** | **100 %** |

### 3.2 Studio Cost Breakdown per Region

| Region | Pre‑prod (fixed) | Voice‑Actor (€/hr) | Studio (€/min) | Post‑mix (€/min) | Licensing (% of total) |
|--------|-----------------|--------------------|----------------|------------------|------------------------|
| SEA | $200 | €45 | €12 | €5 | 6 % |
| ME | $300 | €60 | €18 | €6 | 7 % |
| LAT | $250 | €50 | €15 | €5 | 5 % |
| EU | $350 | €75 | €20 | €7 | 8 % |

> *Tip*: Negotiate volume‑based rate‑discounts up to **10 %** for > 10 titles in a single quarter.

---

## 4️⃣ Legal & Regulatory Compliance Checklist

| Region | Key Regulations | Required Approvals | Timeline | Owner |
|--------|-----------------|--------------------|----------|-------|
| SEA | Content Rating by National Agencies; Data Privacy (PDPA, etc.) | Local content rating; Data‑use consent | 3 weeks | Legal‑Compliance |
| ME | ARabic Content Licensing, Islamic Cultural Guidelines, Censorship laws | Arabic script approval; religious compliance | 4 weeks | Local Counsel |
| LAT | Copyright law (Spanish and Portuguese translations); Data Protection | Translated script clearance; GDPR/CCPA for subtitles | 3 weeks | Legal‑Compliance |
| EU | CEUR, GDPR, National Labour Law for voice‑actors | EU copyright; voice‑actor contracts | 5 weeks | EU Legal |

> **Escalation**: If any approval is pending > 50 % of planned release window, pause local launch and re‑schedule.

---

## 5️⃣ Cultural Sensitivity Checklist (CS‑Checklist – Sample for MENA)

| # | Item | Green | Yellow | Red | Notes |
|---|------|-------|--------|-----|-------|
| 1 | Use of religious text in dialogue | ✔️ | ❌ | ❌ | Avoid direct quotes |
| 2 | Gender pronouns | ✔️ | ✔️ | ❌ | Use gender‑neutral if possible |
| 3 | Political references | ✔️ | ❌ | ❌ | Avoid local politics |
| 4 | Food & drink imagery | ✔️ | ✔️ | ❌ | No alcohol references |
| 5 | Facial expressions depicting anger | ✔️ | ✔️ | ❌ | Ensure cultural acceptability |

**Flagging Process**  
- **Green**: Pass to next stage.  
- **Yellow**: Requires script rewrite or dubbing adjustment.  
- **Red**: Immediate content removal or significant rewrite.

---

## 6️⃣ AI‑Dubbing Quality Assurance (QA)

| Step | Tool | Threshold | Human Check | Output |
|------|------|-----------|-------------|--------|
| 1 | Voice‑Clone Generation | Confidence > 0.88 | • If **≤ 0.88** → Full human dubbing | AI‑dub only |
| 2 | Linguistic Sync | < 50 ms lead/lag | • If **> 50 ms** → Manual retiming | Clean sync |
| 3 | Cultural Review | CS‑Checklist pass | • Any Red→ Re‑write | Cultural fit |
| 4 | Phonetic Accuracy | 98 % match | • < 98 % → Manual edit | Accurate dialogue |

> **Audit**: Quarterly audit trail of AI‑dub > 10 % of total dub volume; 100 % of Red items must be escalated to Tier‑1 studio.

---

## 7️⃣ Marketing Execution Plans

| Region | Dominant Platform | Preferred Content Format | Engagement Target | Example Campaign |
|--------|-------------------|--------------------------|-------------------|------------------|
| SEA | TikTok, Instagram Reels, WhatsApp | 15‑second “Behind‑the‑Voice” reels, “Duet” challenges | 15 % clip completion | “Who’s your Favourite Voice Actor?” challenge |
| ME | Instagram, TikTok, local forums (Twitter Arabic) | 30‑second “Cultural Spotlight” short‑movies | 12 % click‑through | “Mysterious Narration” teaser |
| LAT | Facebook Groups, WhatsApp, YouTube | 1‑minute “Fan‑Translation” teasers, Meme‑series | 10 % fan‑generated content | “Translate & Win” meme contest |
| EU | Instagram Reels, TikTok, Discord | 10‑sec “Dub‑vs‑Sub” comparison ads | 20 % share rate | “Which is better?” poll |

**Regional Calendar Alignment**  
- **July‑2026**: Drop “Global Fan‑Event” on the same day as local release in each region. Adjust for Ramadan, Diwali, etc. by shifting to off‑peak days.

---

## 8️⃣ Fandom Engagement Engine

| KPI | Target | Metric Definition | Measurement Tool |
|-----|--------|-------------------|-----------------|
| **Fan‑Generated Subtitle QA** | ≥ 90 % meet quality threshold within 48 hrs | % of community-supplied subtitles passing automated linting | Community Portal UI |
| **Ambassador Revenue Share** | €1 / month per active fan‑ambassador | Tokenized points redeemed for merch | DAO platform |
| **Fan‑Community Growth** | +20 % active users per quarter | Number of profile sign‑ups in fan portal | Internal analytics |
| **Meme Amplification** | 30 % monthly lift in social shares | Shares of platform‑curated meme | Social‑metrics dashboard |

---

## 9️⃣ Expanded Risk & Mitigation Matrix

| Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation | Budget Buffer |
|------|--------|------------|------------|---------------|
| Studio Delivery Delay | 30 % release delay | Medium | 3‑month backup studio contract | 5 % of locale budget |
| AI‑Dub Mis‑translation | Brand backlash | Medium | Human QA threshold 0.88 | 2 % |
| Legal Censorship Change | Revocation of title | High | Real‑time legal watch; rapid rewrite | 5 % |
| Fan‑Generated Content Leak | Reputation damage | Low | Pre‑screening & watermark | 1 % |
| Currency Volatility | Cost overrun | Medium | Lock rates via hedging | 3 % |
| Platform outage during launch | Subscriber churn | Low | 2 hr redundancy plan | 2 % |
| Data‑Privacy Breach | GDPR penalty | Low | Data audit & encryption | 3 % |

---

## 🔟 ROI & Value Metrics

### 10.1 Incremental Revenue Per Title (IRPT)

**IRPT = (Avg. ΔSubscribers × Avg. ARPU) + (ΔAd‑Revenue per Episode)**

| Region | Avg. ΔSubscribers | Avg. ARPU (€) | ΔAd‑Revenue per Episode (€) | IRPT (€) |
|-------|-------------------|---------------|-----------------------------|----------|
| SEA | +5 000 | 1.2 | 0.15 | 6 400 |
| ME | +4 000 | 1.0 | 0.10 | 4 200 |
| LAT | +3 500 | 1.3 | 0.12 | 5 500 |
| EU | +6 000 | 1.5 | 0.20 | 9 000 |

### 10.2 Payback Period (PP)

> **PP (months) = Total Spend ÷ Monthly ΔRevenue**

| Region | Spend (€) | Monthly ΔRevenue (€) | PP |
|--------|-----------|----------------------|----|
| SEA | 300 k | 1 200 | 10 |
| ME | 250 k | 1 000 | 12.5 |
| LAT | 200 k | 900 | 22.2 |
| EU | 350 k | 1 200 | 9.2 |

> *Action*: Re‑allocate 10 % of the SEA budget to EU to shift PP from 12.5 to 9.2 months.

### 10.3 Cultural Resonance Index (CRI)

> **CRI = (Sentiment Score × 0.4) + (Replay Rate × 0.4) + (NPS × 0.2)**

| Region | Sentiment 0‑10 | Replay % | NPS | CRI |
|--------|---------------|----------|-----|-----|
| SEA | 7.8 | 35 % | 48 | 7.8 |
| ME | 6.9 | 28 % | 42 | 7.0 |
| LAT | 7.3 | 32 % | 45 | 7.4 |

## ①️⃣ Governance & Cross‑Functional Collaboration

| Function | Role | Decision Rights | Reporting |
|----------|------|----------------|-----------|
| Finance | Budget approval | Approve total spend, contingency | GL‑Finance Steering |
| Legal | Compliance vetting | Approve legal documents | GL‑Legal |
| Product | Build‑out of localization hubs | Author platform features | Product Ops |
| Marketing | Campaign strategy | Approve creative assets | Marketing Exec |

> **Governance Board**: GL‑LCR (Global Localization & Compliance Ref), quarterly review of performance against KPIs.

---

## ②️⃣ Localization Asset Production Flow

1. **Script Acquisition** – Original Korean script → global translation hub.  
2. **Pre‑Localisation** – CS‑Checklist review, legal approval.  
3. **Voice‑Actor Casting** – Regional database; AI‑clone if approved.  
4. **Studio Recording** – Tier‑1 studio for critical markets; Tier‑2 AI + QA for rest.  
5. **Post‑Production** – Sync, mixing, QA.  
6. **Metadata Localization** – Titles, tags, synopsis, keyword tagging.  
7. **Quality Sign‑off** – C‑Level QA lead & legal sign-off before platform upload.  
8. **Deployment** – Schedule with regional product PMs.  
9. **Post‑Launch Monitoring** – Sentiment dashboard & feedback loop.

---

## ③️⃣ Implementation Road‑Map with Dependency Matrix

| Quarter | Milestone | Dependency | Owner | Risk Buffer |
|---------|-----------|------------|-------|-------------|
| Q2 2026 | Finalize A‑PE, CS‑Checklist, AI‑dub QA | Survey roll‑out | Market Research | 2 weeks |
| Q3 2026 | Sign Tier‑1 studio contracts (SEA, ME) | Legal approval | Legal‑Compliance | 1 week |
| Q4 2026 | Pilot localized titles (SEA, ME) | Pre‑prod & voice‑actor pipeline | Production | 3 days |
| Q1 2027 | QA of AI‑dub Tier‑2 (LAT, EU) | AI vendor audit | Tech Ops | 2 days |
| Q2 2027 | Roll‑out marketing calendar & fan portal | Local content | Marketing Ops | 1 week |
| Q3 2027 | Full 8‑title slate launch | All approvals | PLM | +1 week |
| Q4 2027 | ROI & KPI review; budget re‑allocation | Data capture | Finance | 2 weeks |

*Checkpoints*: Every milestone ends with a **Compliance & QA Sign‑off**. If any fails, rollback to previous checkpoint and revise.

---

## ④️⃣ Post‑Release Sentiment Dashboard

| Metric | Threshold | Action |
|--------|-----------|--------|
| **Negative Sentiment Spike** (> 15 % increase) | Immediate alert | Initiate content review; issue correction |
| **NPS Drop > 5 points** | Weekly review | Scale fan‑engagement initiatives |
| **CRi Drop > 0.5** | Monthly review | Re‑balance dub/sub mix |
| **View‑Through Drop > 10 %** | Event‑driven | Deploy targeted promos |

> **Feedback Loop**: All metrics flow into the A‑PE to update RPI quarterly.

---

## ⑤️⃣ Alignment with Platform Strategic Pillars

| Pillar | Playbook Link | KPI |
|--------|--------------|-----|
| **K‑Drama Market Expansion** | Tier‑1 dubbing for high‑traffic titles | +5 % market share |
| **Content Risk Diversification** | Region‑specific CS‑Checklists & local compliance | No legal breaches |
| **Subscriber LTV Growth** | Fan‑community ROI model, NPS | +0.7 LTV per subscriber |
| **Global Brand Positioning** | Cross‑regional transmedia events | 10 % brand sentiment lift |

---

## ⑥️⃣ Summary & Decision Matrix

| Decision | Considerations | Rationale |
|----------|----------------|-----------|
| **Allocate more budget to SEA dub** | RPI rising, high subscriber growth | Capitalise on high ROI |
| **Limit EU dubbing to Tier‑1** | Higher cost, moderate ROI | Avoid over‑spend |
| **Scale AI‑dub to 30 % of LAT titles** | Lower cost, risk acceptable | Balance cost vs quality |
| **Increase fan‑ambassador stipend** | Higher fan participation leads to content virality | Boosts retention |

---

### Next Steps

1. **Enter budget cap** (e.g., $15 M) into the scalable cost model to see spend distribution.  
2. **Set 90‑day RPI review** to adjust media mix.
